nodes.label: SpacetimeDB Vacky implementation guide
nodes.description: Source document; claims retain their dated/historical/proposed status.

nodes.label: Reducer persistence boundary
nodes.description: SpacetimeDB owns persistent tables, constraints, reducers and safe reads; Next.js owns web/auth shell and external side effects.
nodes.rationale: Reducers cannot perform external network I/O, so email, cookies, password hashing and redirects stay in Next.js.

nodes.label: Application session to SpacetimeDB identity mapping
nodes.description: Guide explicitly warns native OIDC identity is not interchangeable with first-party cookie sessions.
nodes.rationale: Authorization must explicitly map Next.js session state to SpacetimeDB identity.

nodes.label: Stable generated bindings
nodes.description: Choose stable module_bindings location; do not hand-edit generated files.

nodes.label: Ownership verification checklist
nodes.description: Verify valid/invalid/unauthorized reducer inputs, user ownership, generation, lint and build.
